title: neto2 trained longer, in closed loop on validation links: 30 policies (5 arms, 3 seeds, 2 neto1s) beside the rule
description: exp-neto2-search2-245 trained expliCCit's memoryless actor offline from the step data of exp-data-net2-steps-222 on neto1 v1 (7 heads, release exp-net1-point-228) and neto1 v2 (27 heads, release exp-neto1-v2-239), the arms of experiments/specs/net2/offline-search2.json: TD3+BC at alpha 5 for 60000, 200000 and 600000 steps, TD3+BC at alpha 10 and IQL at expectile 0.7 and beta 3 for 200000 steps, each over training seeds 0, 1 and 2. Its release holds training diagnostics only. Here every policy runs in closed loop (neto2-NET1-ARM-sSEED) beside the fixed rule on neto1 v1 at u = 0.125 (rule-pt, chosen in exp-rule-net1point-val-234), the rule on neto1 v2 at u = 0.125, 0.25 and 0.375 (rule-v2-uU; 0.375 was chosen in exp-rule-27heads-val-241) and BBRv3, on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies, campaign seed 21. summary.md scores each controller against BBRv3 and names the best policy on each net1 (chosen.json); versus-rule-pt.md pairs each controller with the rule on neto1 v1 by link. It answers whether longer training closes the gap to the rule that exp-neto2-search-val-244 left, and how far training seeds spread. This is a search on validation links and supports no claim about neto2 on the held-out test links.
prepare: N1="$IN/v1/$(cat "$IN/v1/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N2="$IN/v2/$(cat "$IN/v2/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/pt" "$N1" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v2" "$N2" --u 0.125 0.25 0.375; P=(--policy "rule-pt=$OUT/pt/rule-u0.125.onnx" --policy "rule-v2-u0.125=$OUT/v2/rule-u0.125.onnx" --policy "rule-v2-u0.25=$OUT/v2/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v2-u0.375=$OUT/v2/rule-u0.375.onnx"); for a in "$IN"/p/neto2-*; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$a")=$a/policy.onnx"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s --best neto2-v1 neto2-v2 && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-pt
